title: こういうの、ロマンでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Resolve a Real-Life Riddle: The Mysterious Tiara and the Manor of the Phantom Thief…" What could this billboard be advertising? It looks amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Absolutely! Having a whole manor to play the game… Hehe, my heart's thumping already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the game starts, we're given a full explanation by the master of the manor. Apparently, a phantom pilferer has infiltrated the building.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: So essentially, this thief has adopted the guise of a servant and, in order to win, we have to identify them!
choice_data_list: And if they steal the treasure, we lose.
And if they steal the treasure, we lose.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: In that case… you there, the maid in the back! May I ask you a few questions?
choice_data_list: You're sure not wasting any time!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, the situation is changing every minute. And I'd like to get the investigation portion done while everybody's here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion has always been one to leap into action. It's probably best that I lend her my full support so we can pinpoint the culprit!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: This detached building is pretty shabby, isn't it? But there might be a hint of some sort hidden in a place like this where nobody would think to look…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, my. This cloak… Its design seems way more contemporary than the armor it adorns! Maybe it belongs to our thief?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah! Just now, something's glistening above us! Trainer, would you mind hoisting me up? I'd like to investigate further.
choice_data_list: Sure, but one of us might get hurt if I lose my grip.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see… Very well. Captain, would you mind lifting Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Security Captain
text_block_list.text: But of course! Ahem, pardon me. Hup!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of evidence awaits us in this courtyard…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Goodness! Good day, fellow detectives! ♪ Have you found anything?

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text: Actually, we were just gathering up all the clues we've got. And that's when we found…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: An abandoned shoe and some broken lipstick… I see!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hm. Have we already been everywhere there is to go?
choice_data_list: We've been to every room on the manor map.
We've been to every room on the manor map.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wow! You've been making a note of all the places we found clues! Cheers, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Which means… that should be the last of the material evidence. I can feel the truth approaching…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her having such a good time puts me at ease. I go to ask if there's anything else I can help her with, but the moment I open my mouth…

text_block_list.name: Master of the Manor
text_block_list.text: Nwhaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh my, that voice just now…

text_block_list.name: Master of the Manor
text_block_list.text: The t-tiara… It's vanished from the safe!

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text: What?! Wait… Nobody's said "game over" yet, so that must mean…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The thief is still inside the manor! Perhaps the tiara is too large for them to simply sneak away with.

text_block_list.name: Participant B
text_block_list.text: Eep! So it's not just the thief we have to find, but the hidden tiara too?

text_block_list.name: Participant A
text_block_list.text: Okay. If it's come to this, let's split up and search! The thief and the tiara are both inside the manor!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay, now's our chance!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Trainer, can you quietly come with me? I think this is our chance to catch the thief. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: If we take this bookcase, and… There we go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ka-thunk! Rumble, rumble, rumble…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I knew it—a hidden room. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Actually, secret passages hidden behind bookcases are pretty common. You know, as escape routes for VIPs!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: And also, in circumstances such as these where everybody's running about in a panic…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: They provide an ideal means of quietly escaping with stolen tiaras… You catch my drift? ♪

text_block_list.name: Maid
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What are you doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ha! I had my suspicions you were the thief. For one thing, your toes always seemed to be pointed toward the safe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Well, people have a tendency to point their toes towards the object of their attention. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But I'm sure you're still confused! After all, the puzzle has yet to be solved, yet we're still here! Well, it's all thanks to Operation Ambush!
choice_data_list: I never should have doubted you!
I wonder if this is allowed…

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. It's an honor to receive such praise.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Aaand it was also pretty thrilling to uncover someone's secret scheme again. It's been a while, you know. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't help being impressed listening to her talk as if this were an ordinary matter. I come away from the event with new respect for Fine Motion's sharp mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, it might not be. The maid was certainly quite shocked.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Still… I believe they say that in times of emergency, one should be flexible and unhindered by common sense or custom.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Besides, we didn't do anything that would trouble the other participants… right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion flashes a knowing smile. Unsure how to interpret her expression, I have no choice but to nod along.
